about_the_game:
STORY

A.D. xxxx, the world collapsed. A virus spread, people's contact was severed, and the world became one where unexpressed feelings were locked away. However, a revolutionary technology to save the world is born...

ABOUT SPARK!

The virtual emotion shoot system "SPARK!," developed to transform and convey unexpressed feelings into actions. People access VR space and spend their days clashing with a variety of feelings. You can take on various characters and convey your precious feelings by shooting a "photon sphere" at the heart of the person you want to convey them to!

BASIC

It's a game created in a VR space, surrounded by walls on all four sides. Players shoot spheres at each other, aiming to get their sphere into the opponent's goal, which requires quick reflexes and strategy.
・Customize your character and sparkling effects

・Clear multiple storylines

・Unlock avatar items by clearing stories

EMO SHOOT SYSTEM

The greatest feature that makes "SPARK!" exciting is the "Emo Shoot System."

When you shoot a sphere into your opponent's court, and they don't touch it, the sphere reflects off the wall and comes back. Each time you chase and hit the returning sphere, it powers up.

If you hit it 3 consecutive times, the sphere enters "SPARK!!" mode, and you can "break" the opponent player to aim for the now-empty goal!

name: SPARK! -PHOTON BLAST-

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit version 1909 revision .1350 or later, or version 2004 and 20H2 revision .789 or later
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor, 2.5GHz or faster
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or DirectX 12 compatible graphics card. Graphics RAM : 8GB or more
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit version 1909 revision .1350 or later, or version 2004 and 20H2 revision .789 or later
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor, 2.5GHz or faster
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or DirectX 12 compatible graphics card. Graphics RAM : 8GB or more
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 MB available space

short_description: "SPARK! -PHOTON BLAST-" is a sports action game where players face off in a futuristic stadium, rendered with stunningly beautiful photorealistic graphics. Your goal is to score by launching a sphere into your opponent's goal. Enjoy the heart-pounding, high-octane action where every second counts!
